summary.intent: Run the full autonomous GSD ship-phase pipeline (verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit review → ship → resolve PR reviews) for Phase 68 of cipher-box, triaging findings without stopping to ask.
summary.outcome: Verify accepted as already-passing, secure audit closed 41/41 threats, Nyquist validation reached 0 gaps, simplify pass found and fixed a real zeroization-order bug plus removed dead code (3 todos deferred), and the SDK E2E gate went fully green after fixing two environment issues (stale tee-worker container, wrong TEE_WORKER_URL port); CodeRabbit findings were then triaged and fixes applied across web/SDK/API files and STATE.md/ROADMAP.md — transcript ends before the PR was opened/shipped.

repo: GSD's conventional-commit paren rule only forbids parens in the description part; scoped subjects like `feat(sdk):` are valid, so all 86 branch commits already conformed and the filter-branch reword step was a no-op

Locally, TEE_WORKER_URL defaults to :3001 which collides with the mock-ipns-routing service; the real tee-worker for this phase runs on :3002 — misconfiguration causes silent SDK E2E failures that look like code regressions
apps/web's vitest suite (including ipns.service.test.ts) is not wired into any CI job and ipns.service.test.ts fails on main too — pre-existing breakage, not a phase regression
gsd-secure-phase / gsd-validate-phase workflows resolve gsd-tools.cjs via a long fallback chain across ~15 possible config directories before erroring

code.finding: enumerateMoveDescendants zeroed the parent readKey before the children loop finished unsealing with it, misclassifying every depth-2+ move descendant as unreadable — real bug caught during the simplify pass, fixed and covered with a red-green-verified regression test
updateGrant lacked a monotonic guard on rootGeneration; added per CodeRabbit finding plus a new spec case since no service-level updateGrant tests existed
Multiple CodeRabbit-driven fixes applied (error-logging sites, reconcile guard logic) — several edits across the file
Dead code removed: orphaned share.service functions and an unused exported constant left over from the rotation cutover, verified to have zero external importers before deletion

workflow: Running background agents (security auditor, simplify-review agent, client-chain build) in parallel let the orchestrator keep prepping PR content instead of blocking on each step

Red-green verification pattern: after writing a regression test, temporarily revert the fix to confirm the test fails, then reapply to confirm it passes — proves the test actually catches the bug rather than trivially passing
When a test failure might be a pre-existing issue vs. a regression, diff the suspect file against main and swap in main's version to isolate cause before assuming the phase broke something
Deferred/out-of-scope findings get written as dated markdown files under .planning/todos/pending/ rather than fixed inline, keeping the ship pipeline unblocked

friction: SDK E2E gate initially failed because the tee-worker container was still running a pre-Phase-67 contract; required diagnosing via worker/API logs before rebuilding
A second SDK E2E failure was caused by the API's TEE_WORKER_URL pointing at the wrong port (:3001 instead of :3002), requiring another restart cycle

Significant time spent tracing whether ipns.service.test.ts's failure was a phase-induced regression (import chain tracing, diffing against main, swapping in main's file) before confirming it was pre-existing and not even run in CI
gsd workflow scripts embed very verbose repeated shell boilerplate for locating gsd-tools.cjs across many possible install locations
